args.body:
- Temperature excursions in cold-chain logistics fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (~25%).

Sources: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain and https://insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion
args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Combined Summary (Ironbark blog + companion)
